description: This is a Java test class for the MongoTimestampPersistence component, containing setup, teardown, and unit tests for timestamp persistence operations in MongoDB.

classes.name: MongoTimestampPersistenceIT
classes.description: Integration test class for MongoTimestampPersistence, testing timestamp storage and retrieval in MongoDB.

methods.name: startMongoResource
methods.description: Initializes and starts the embedded MongoDB resource; runs once before all tests.

methods.name: stopMongoResource
methods.description: Stops the MongoDB resource and closes clients; runs once after all tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment before each test, creating actor system and initializing persistence.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Cleans up resources after each test, including dropping collection and shutting down actor system.

methods.name: retrieveFallbackForLastSuccessfulSyncTimestamp
methods.description: Tests that getting timestamp before any is set returns an empty Optional.

methods.name: updateAndRetrieveLastSuccessfulSyncTimestamp
methods.description: Verifies updating the timestamp and then retrieving returns the correct value.

methods.name: ensureCollectionIsCapped
methods.description: Checks that the Mongo collection is capped (size limited) during persistence.

methods.name: createCollectionMultipleTimesWithoutError
methods.description: Ensures creating initialized instances multiple times does not cause errors.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Helper method to synchronously retrieve the first element from a source.

methods.name: runBlocking
methods.description: Helper method to block and collect a list of elements from a source.

methods.name: mapAsRuntimeException
methods.description: Maps exceptions to RuntimeExceptions for consistency.
